name: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip
tagline: FAST CURING PREMIUM POLYURETHANE CONSTRUCTION ADHESIVE
summary: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a premium grade one-component polyurethane construction adhesive with good initial grab and high strength after 30 minutes^. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a versatile, fast curing, general purpose construction adhesive suitable for interior and exterior use.
metaDescription: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a premium grade one-component polyurethane construction adhesive with good initial grab and high strength after 30 minutes^. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a versatile, fast curing, general purpose construction adhesive suitable for interior and exterior use.
attributes: Applies white, can dry translucent if applied in thin layers
usage: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is suitable for use in construction and repair applications where a permanent strong bond is required between porous-nonporous surfaces. Suitable for bonding common construction materials such as:
advantages: Applies white, can dry translucent if applied in thin layers

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months if storage conditions are met.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip stored in original, unopened packaging in cool, dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

items.label: Open Time
items.text: Relocation time is approximately 5~10 minutues depending on temperature and ventilation.

items.label: Curing time
items.text: Approximately 30 minutes for initial bond strength, depending on temperature, moisture content of surfaces and adhesive thickness. Some non-porous substrates (such as metal) may require 1 hour to reach initial bond strength. Strength will increase over the next 24 hours.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: All surfaces must be clean and free from all dust, laitance, scale, rust, loose particles, grease and foreign matter.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean up tools and equipment with acetone or white spirit. Cured adhesive can only be removed mechanically.
